spans.s:
A or (before vowels) AN:
I This article
has no equiv. in Sanskrit and is expressed
by the singular number alone:
there is a
large silk-cotton tree on the banks of the Godavari
अस्ति गोदावरीतीरे विशालः शाल्मलीतरुः H. i.;
there
was a king named Cintamani
अभूद्राजा चिन्तामणि-
र्नाम Va.
II But कश्चित् (काचित्, किञ्चित्)
should be added when special attention
is directed to the object: a (certain)
Yaksha
कश्चिद् यक्षः, Me. I 1.; A (certain)
saint named Marichi
कश्चिन्मरीचिर्नाभ भहर्षिः, D.
iii.
III When it means a species of, विशेषः,
 भेदः, etc. should be added: Asoka is a tree
अशोको वृक्षविशेषः।
IV When used distribu-
-tively, (a) expr. by avy. comp. with प्रति,
or, by the repetition of the word in proper
agreement with the verb: give (me)
500
sovereign a day
प्रत्यहं सुवर्णपञ्चशतानि देहि, H.
iii; (b) the simple gen. may be used in
connection with num. adverbs:
dinner
twice a day
द्विरह्नो भोजनम्, V. In O. E. some-
-times=on, in, for: q. v.:
the world runs
awheel
*चक्रैर्जगद्धावति।
